title: Crestline Corporate Travel Agreements Fee Schedule — Late Fee on an Unpaid Invoice
content:
Under Crestline Corporate Travel Agreements a late fee is charged once on each invoice of the agreement that is still unpaid after its due date. The fee is dated on the day it is charged, and it is booked against that invoice's number and due date.

### Item 1 — Amount of the late fee

**1.1 Unpaid amount past due.** The unpaid amount past due is read from the agreement's invoice entries as every invoice charge whose due date falls on or before the fee date, plus every late fee already charged, less every payment received. Invoice charges are taken in by due date over a look-back of 600 calendar months up to the fee date, which reaches every charge of the agreement whose due date is on or before the fee date; a charge whose due date is still to come is left out. Late fees and payments are taken in whole, whatever their dates. The result is held to the cent.

**1.2 Late-fee rate.** The late-fee rate is the tier's late-payment fee percentage.

**1.3 Fee.** The fee is the unpaid amount past due multiplied by the late-fee rate and divided by one hundred, rounded to the cent once at the end.

**1.4 Fee charged.** The late fee charged is the larger of the fee in 1.3 and the tier's minimum late fee.

### Worked figure (hypothetical inputs)

An agreement's invoice entries on a fee date of 20 July show:

| Entry | Amount (USD) | Due date |
|---|---|---|
| invoice charge | 12000.00 | 10 May |
| invoice charge | 8000.00 | 10 June |
| invoice charge | 5000.00 | 10 August |
| late fee already charged | 180.00 | — |
| payment received | 6000.00 | — |

- Unpaid amount past due: 12000.00 and 8000.00 (both due on or before 20 July) plus 180.00, less 6000.00, which is USD 14180.00. The charge due on 10 August is not yet due and is left out.
- For a tier whose late-payment fee percentage is 1.5 and whose minimum late fee is USD 25: 14180.00 multiplied by 1.5 and divided by one hundred is 212.70; the larger of 212.70 and 25 is USD 212.70.
- For a tier whose percentage is 1.0 and whose minimum is USD 50: the fee is 141.80, and USD 141.80 is charged.

### Point of judgement

When the fee in 1.3 falls below the tier's minimum late fee, the minimum is charged: an unpaid amount past due of USD 1200.00 at 1.5 percent gives 18.00, and with a minimum of USD 25 the late fee charged is USD 25.00.
